A '''copper dolabra''' is the [[Copper equipment|copper]] [[dolabra]], crafted from [[Copper Ingot|copper ingots]]. It mines at speed 5 and has 350 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/copper_dolabra.json}}</ref>

As a [[dolabra]], it works as both a pickaxe and an axe, at a lower mining speed than the copper pickaxe or axe.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/copper/dolabra</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines both pickaxe and axe blocks at speed 5.

The copper dolabra has its own rules instead of the copper pickaxe's: it gets no drops from diamond ore (speed 4) or from [[Sulfurous Quartz Deposit|sulfurous quartz]] and [[Sulfur Deposit|sulfur deposits]], but, unlike the copper pickaxe, it can mine [[Native Gold|native gold]] and obsidian with drops.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/copper_dolabra.json}}</ref>

The pack adds beds, candles, cactus and honeycomb blocks to the blocks axes mine quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===

It deals 5 damage with an attack speed of 0.8.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Copper Ingot|copper ingots]]. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Copper Ingot|copper ingot]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/copper_ingot_from_blasting_copper_materials.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|

{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Copper can no longer be smelted in an oven; it needs a mud kiln or blast furnace.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|The blast furnace recipe changed and diamonds now drop raw, which the release notes describe as extending the copper and iron ages. Dolabras were redefined as axe (tool) and pickaxe hybrids rather than weapons: damage goes down and weapon intrinsics are removed over time.}}
